recommended_setup: Keep academic year in course shortname/idnumber, cohort idnumber, and custom fields. Do not rename old year courses.
why: Preserves gradebook, completion, attendance/plugin history, and audit trail.

recommended_setup: Keep Board > School > Medium > Class > Stream as stable categories; avoid division categories.
why: Categories organize courses. Divisions change frequently and are better handled inside courses.
example: GSEB > Green Valley School > Gujarati Medium > Std 11 > Science

recommended_setup: Use Moodle groups for divisions inside each course.
why: Groups are course-level and can restrict activities/teacher views by division.
example: Course Physics: Division A, Division B

recommended_setup: Use one cohort per academic year + board + medium + grade + stream + division.
why: Cohort sync handles bulk enrolment into all subject courses.

recommended_setup: Add student to next-year cohort first; remove old cohort only after old-year reports are backed up.
why: Removing a synced cohort may remove course access/enrolment from old-year courses.
example: Add GVS-2027...; keep GVS-2026... until closure.

recommended_setup: Move the student into next academic year but same grade/stream cohort.
why: Student repeats standard but belongs to new academic year batch.
example: STD08 GEN B 2026 -> STD08 GEN A 2027

recommended_setup: For Std 10 to Std 11, promotion file must specify selected stream.
why: Moodle cannot infer Science/Commerce/Arts automatically from grade.
example: STD10 GEN B -> STD11 SCI A

recommended_setup: Do not create subject cohorts for pass-out students; update status to Alumni and optionally place in an Alumni cohort/category.
why: Keeps old records while avoiding unnecessary new course enrolments.

recommended_setup: Update status to Transferred or Left; do not delete user.
why: Deletion can damage audit trail and reporting.

recommended_setup: Hide old courses or move to Archive category after backups; do not reset if records must be retained.
why: New academic year should have clean courses while old records remain intact.
